hypothesis: Do independently learned character ngrams and reusable suffix chunks generate authentic unseen full words from identical visible three-character word prefixes and side context more faithfully than a fitted prefix lexicon, under bounded training/storage/inference costs?
scope_warning: Public Alice text is not blinded science. Word-prefix completion does NOT demonstrate latent cognition, reasoning, free text creation, general language generation, coding or full LLM comparability.

external_source.verification: Require exact raw bytes + Git blob SHA1 before UTF8 parse, never commit source.

source.physical_line_split: Raw UTF8 splitlines, chronological first70% TRAIN, next15% SELECT, last15% DEV
source.tokenization: lowercase regex [a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)? on each original physical line, 9..50 tokens
source.target: one word length5..18 matching [a-z]+ among interior indexes 3..len-4, selected by SHA256(namespace+':'+physical index) first8 modulo candidates. Expose only first3 letters plus last3/next3 words; gold full word for TRAIN/SELECT fitting and DEV scoring only
source.split_identity: First unique windows per chronological role, exact physical line and canonical seven-word windows disjoint; fail on shortages
source.model_information: Same public train gold/input for all models, no source gold or role/line ordinal exposed at inference

arms.WORD_PREFIX_LEXICON: Fitted training target word counts restricted to exact first3 chars, use training left/right conditional context smoothed counts; if none, emit prefix as abstention
arms.CHAR_BIGRAM_BEAM: Train character order2 transitions, beam12, max word len18, length penalty .04 per added character, smoothed counts .5; prefix-conditioned
arms.CHAR_TRIGRAM_BEAM: Train character order3 transitions, same beam/cost protocol
arms.CHAR_4GRAM_BEAM: Train character order4 transitions, same beam/cost protocol
arms.CHAR_TRIGRAM_PLUS_CONTEXT: Trigram beam12, rerank by frozen TRAIN word left/right context add0.5 smoothed logprob weight .35. Complete trigram+context fit/storage costs.
arms.SUFFIX_CHUNK_REUSE: Fit terminal suffix chunks length1..5 conditioned visible 3letter prefix if present else global suffix, add0.5, concatenate highest-count suffix to prefix; may emit unseen words.

selection: All hyperparameters frozen; SELECT is report-only and cannot tune model or beam. Same TRAIN exposure but different fit resources and parameter counts, no Pareto GO.
metrics: Exact full word and char accuracy / normalized edit distance
Unseen-TRAIN-target word DEV exact accuracy and OOV fraction
Novel output fraction, prefix violation, abstention
Full checkpoint and training corpus bytes
native_acceptance: Windows/Linux tests; source exact SHA and each arm role output SHA + numeric fidelity exact, independent comparator fail-closed, Linux Go test vet build and separate FORGE full PR regression.
decision: NO SCIENTIFIC GO from synthetic prefix completion; preserve all unfavorable results; no old DEV retuning or protected first-use.
